losing_trade_autopsy.methodology: Analyzed all 7d losers by signal, regime, and hourly distribution. Cross-referenced with winners.

findings.root_cause: Momentum filter was backwards — blocked SHORT with rising momentum (65%WR, the ONLY profitable state) and allowed flat/falling (39-41%WR). Fix deployed 14:30 UTC Sep 20.
findings.entry_check: All losers were ATR_SL exits — standard stop loss hits, not entry quality issues. The momentum filter was letting in wrong-direction trades.
findings.recommended_change: Already fixed (CEO 14:30 UTC). Monitor 48h for impact.
findings.impact_on_winners: Fix BLOCKS flat/falling momentum SHORTs (losers) and ALLOWS rising momentum SHORTs (winners). Net positive.

findings.root_cause: Standard variance at 50%WR. No single root cause — losses distributed across EXTREME (6T), HIGH (7T), NORMAL (6T). Biggest single loss: BABY -$0.32 (HIGH, 02:06 UTC).
findings.entry_check: All ATR_SL exits. pump-chain+ at 50%WR with 42T/7d is within expected range for a momentum signal.
findings.recommended_change: No action. This is the system's workhorse — 50%WR with PM_TRAIL capturing winners is acceptable. The 7d PnL is +$2.45.

findings.root_cause: pump-chain+ LONG fires in dead zone hours with 13.3% WR (15T). Hours 00, 02, 04 all 0%WR.
findings.entry_check: TIME_BLOCK penalty (0.7x) covers 01-09 but hour 00 is outside. Hour 00 has 3T 0%WR -$0.41.
findings.recommended_change: Expand TIME_BLOCK_START from 1 to 0. Would add hour 00 coverage. Conservative — penalty not hard block.
findings.impact_on_winners: Hour 00: volume-breakout-long+ 2T +$0.32 would be penalized (0.7x). Net: save -$0.41 from pump-chain+, lose ~$0.09 from volume-breakout. Net +$0.32/7d.
findings.confidence: MEDIUM — sample size 12T in hour 00 is small. Monitor 48h first.
findings.timing: NOT THIS RUN — TIME_BLOCK already extended today (03→01 at 07:30). Same-day double change = HIGH RISK.
